title: A Sewing Primer

fields.name: A Sewing Primer
fields.examine: Everything you ever wanted to know about maintaining your clothing. Researching it will improve your Mending Skill.

intro: A Sewing Primer is a Research Book used to improve the Mending skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: A Skeleton And Note

fields.examine: Human remains resting on a scrap of paper. Some of the bones appear burnt.

intro: }}A Skeleton And Note is an item found during Sutherland's Tale.

title: Accelerant
intro: Accelerant is a tool that aids in lighting fires. It comes in a container labeled Quickflame and stacks in the inventory.

title: Advanced Guns Guns Guns!

fields.name: Advanced Guns Guns Guns!
fields.examine: Packed full of advice and technical details about how to be a better shooter. Researching this will improve your Rifle Firearm Skill.

intro: Advanced Guns Guns Guns! is a Research Book used to improve the Rifle Firearm skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Astrid's Backpack
intro: Astrid's Backpack is a Tool found in the prologue of Episode 1: Do Not Go Gentle. It is placed inside Mackenzie's floatplane in order to progress the story. After the plane crash, the backpack is found next to Astrid's Hardcase, but serves as an ordinary lootable Backpack at this point, containing a Granola Bar, Fleece Mittens, and Antibiotics.

title: Barb's Rifle

fields.name: Barb's Rifle
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: A pale green .303 with a custom stock. A trucker's companion and a durable friend on the open road.; ; Reliable beyond all else.

intro: The unique perk of Barb's Rifle's is that it degrades 18% slower than the standard hunting rifle, this means a full condition Barb's Rifle can fire up to 89 shots at base Rifle Skill before breaking. This durability comes at the cost of weight as it's custom stock increases the gun's base weight to 4.50 kg, which is 0.50 kg heavier than the Hunting Rifle.

title: Bear Skin Bedroll

fields.name: Bear Skin Bedroll
fields.repair: 1 × [Cloth]; 1 × [Cured Black Bear Hide]; 50% Condition; (62.5% Mending Lv.5)

intro: The Bear Skin Bedroll is a tool for sleeping without a bed in The Long Dark.

fields.examine: A large defensive weapon, designed to pierce the thick hides of charging predators. For those with the heart to wield it.

title: Bedroll
intro: This is about the normal cloth bedroll. For a list of other bedrolls see here.

title: Bolt Cutters

fields.examine: A heavy tool designed to cut through metal bolts and chains.

intro: Bolt Cutters are a Tool used briefly in Wintermute to open locked gates at specific points in the story. Bolt Cutter can then be carried or dropped after this point and serve no other function for the remainder of the Episode.

title: Book

fields.name: Book
fields.examine: Eventually, a source of knowledge. For now, something to burn when you are freezing.

intro: A Book is a material item in The Long Dark.

title: Brand

fields.name: Brand
fields.examine: The Brand is a burning stick that serves as a small torch. Provides a bit of light, and might be useful against wildlife.

intro: A Brand was a Tool introduced in the Tireless Menace update in Survival Mode during the Alpha builds of The Long Dark and was eventually cut in the Faithful Cartographer update. It is currently considered Cut/Discontinued Content, but can still be experienced by using the Time Capsule.

title: Broken Arrow
intro: Harvesting a Broken Arrow yields 2 Crow Feathers and 1 Arrowhead, one less feather than harvesting a useable arrow. Therefore, harvesting an arrow before it breaks does conserve one feather at the cost of one less use per Arrow Shaft. It has no other use than to be broken down.

title: Broken Bear Spear

fields.name: Broken Bear Spear
fields.examine: A broken spearhead attached to a salvageable maple shaft.

intro: Broken Bear Spear is a Tools item found in Episode 2: Luminance Fugue of Wintermute.

title: Broken Fire Hardened Arrow
intro: A Broken Fire Hardened Arrow a broken version of a Fire Hardened Arrow that has become too badly damaged to function. Unlike Broken Arrows, Broken Fire Hardened Arrows are not found in the game world. They can be harvested for 1 Crow Feather in 5 minutes. Curiously, they weigh 0.05 Kg more than their unbroken counterparts.<gallery>

title: Broken Hatch Wheel

fields.examine: A piece of Joplin's Bunker, Wyatt's final resting place.

intro: It is found after returning Wyatt's Skeleton and then destroying Prepper's Abandoned Cache. It must be placed in the Trade Drop Box as the 5th Special Request to Sutherland to advance his questline.

title: Broken Manufactured Arrow

fields.examine: A broken Manufactured Arrow. Cannot be harvested.

intro: It is only acquired after a Manufactured Arrow finally breaks at low Condition, and cannot be harvested.

title: Bunker Rifle

fields.examine: A lightweight, agile firearm. Its maneuverable composite stock also makes it less durable. A style in favour among Great Bear Island preppers and other types who like to plan for the worst.

intro: The Bunker Rifle stands out from other rifles on Great Bear, as it features a grey-blue polymer furniture resembling more modern hunting rifles. Optimized for maximum weight savings, it features cutout holes on the stock and grip; reducing its total unloaded weight to a mere 1.50 Kg, as well as halving the rate of aim stamina drain. The rifle is extremely fragile and will degrade a whopping 4% con

title: Burned Out Fuse

fields.name: Burned Out Fuse
fields.examine: Burned out fuse. Needs replacing.

intro: }}Burned Out Fuse is an item that's exclusive to Episode 3 in Wintermute in the final mission, Aftermath.

title: Bushcraft Bow

fields.examine: A highly-improvised Bow fit for the backcountry. Heavier and powerful, if also more fragile.

intro: The Bushcraft bow is a handmade cable-backed bow with a cloth wrapped handle, black stripe tips, and distinct green colored string. It deals the most damage to wildlife when compared to other bows, and degrades slightly slower than the survival bow, however, the Bushcraft Bow has the potential to break much earlier than other bows; starting at 50% condition instead of 15%.

title: Camera

fields.examine: A mechanical instant film Camera. Compatible with Colour, Black and White, and Sepia instant film packs.

intro: The Camera is a Tool found in Survival Mode in The Long Dark. It is available for players that purchase the Tales from the Far Territory expansion, and is designed to be an in game photo/screenshot system for custom photos.

title: Campfire
intro: A Campfire is an open Fire that can be placed into the outdoors. Campfires can cook meat to make it safer to eat, melt snow into Water and sterilize it, make beverages, heat canned food/beverages, scare off predators and create Torches.

title: Can Opener

fields.name: Can Opener
fields.examine: An implement for opening cans.

intro: A Can Opener is a tool primarily used for opening food cans.

title: Can of Gunpowder

fields.name: Can of Gunpowder
fields.examine: Explosive powder. A valuable ingredient when Crafting Ammunition. Also handy as a fire accelerant.
fields.renewable: Yes ([Beachcombing] the crafting ingredients or ammuition that can be harvested, [Trader] for ammunition that can be harvested)

intro: Can of Gunpowder is an item in The Long Dark.

title: Car Battery
intro: Car Batteries are a crafting item in The Long Dark.

title: Cardboard Matches
intro: Cardboard Matches are Fire Starting Tools and a small light source in The Long Dark.

title: Cash

fields.name: Cash
fields.examine: A bundle of cash. Pretty much worthless these days. Useful as tinder.

intro: Cash is a Fire Starting item that can be used as tinder to start fires. Its appearance is of a green Canadian $20 note - the former currency of Great Bear Island and Canada before The Collapse.

title: Cat Tail Head

fields.name: Cat Tail Head
fields.examine: The Cat Tail's seed head, can be used as tinder.

intro: Cat Tail Heads are tinder item in The Long Dark, obtained by harvesting Cat Tail plants.

title: Cedar Firewood

fields.name: Cedar Firewood
fields.examine: Cedar burns with an aromatic glow, but doesn't burn for long.

intro: Cedar Firewood is a fuel item in The Long Dark.

title: Charcoal

fields.name: Charcoal
fields.examine: A piece of charcoal typically found in burned out campfires. Useful for sketching.

intro: Charcoal is a tool in The Long Dark.

title: Coal

fields.name: Coal
fields.examine: Lump of Coal.

intro: Coal is a fuel item in The Long Dark.

title: Cooking Pot

fields.name: Cooking Pot
fields.examine: A sturdy pot for melting snow, boiling water, and cooking food.

intro: A Cooking Pot is a tool primarily used for melting snow, boiling water, and Cooking food. A cooking pot will reduce the amount of time required for food inside it to cook by 20% and will allow for the creation of broths, stews, and porridges that cannot be cooked directly by the fire.

title: Cooking Skillet

fields.name: Cooking Skillet
fields.examine: A pan for cooking and frying.

intro: A cooking skillet can hold up to 1.00 liters of liquid for melting snow or boiling water. This makes it inferior in this respect to the Cooking Pot given it weighs the same. However, it does allow more recipes to be cooked compared to the pot.

title: Cougar Claw Knife

fields.name: Cougar Claw Knife
fields.examine: Crafted from the remains of a deadly predator. A powerful defensive weapon during Struggles.

intro: }}A Cougar Claw Knife is a Tool that can be crafted at a Forge after finding and killing the elusive and lethal Cougar for its Cougar Claw.

title: Crank Light

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things]
fields.examine: An emergency light source. Repeatedly crank the the (sic) handle to charge the built-in battery.
fields.actions: Turn on. Turn off. Crank handle

intro: }}The Crank Light is a Tools item found exclusively in Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things in the Wintermute story.

title: Curator's Rifle

fields.name: Curator's Rifle
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: This .303 extracts a terrible price at distance thanks to its meticulous construction. Missing from the collection of an enigmatic local collector of rare firearms, this weapon is oiled and engraved for purpose.; ; A legacy at work.

intro: The Curator's Rifle in addition to looking fancy, offers an increased range of 33.3% over the standard Hunting Rifle [Around 66 meters]. Unlike the other variants this bonus comes with no downside, making it a direct upgrade to the standard Hunting Rifle.

title: Distress Pistol

fields.name: Distress Pistol
fields.examine: A device used to launch an emergency beacon into the air. Fires Flare Shells.

intro: The Distress Pistol (often called a "Flare Gun") is a single-shot weapon in The Long Dark.

title: Distress Pistol Kit
intro: The Distress Pistol Kit is an item found at the beginning of Episode 1: Do Not Go Gentle in the mission Memories. It is found inside the Jackrabbit Remote Transport, and is one of 3 extra items that can be placed inside Mackenzie's Floatplane (along with Astrid's Hardcase and Astrid's Backpack) before takeoff.

title: Document Stash 1

fields.examine: An old lockbox.

intro: It is found in a Loose Bricks Stash in the Stockpile Prepper Cache and contains Wyatt's Lost Papers 1 and Bunker Schematic Fragment 1. It must be placed in the Trade Drop Box as the 1st Special Request to Sutherland to advance his questline.

title: Document Stash 2

fields.examine: An old lockbox.

intro: It is found in a Loose Bricks Stash in the Hunter Prepper Cache and contains Wyatt's Lost Papers 2 and Bunker Schematic Fragment 2. It must be placed in the Trade Drop Box as the 2nd Special Request to Sutherland to advance his questline.

title: Document Stash 3

fields.examine: An old lockbox.

intro: It is found in a Loose Bricks Stash in the Conspiracy Prepper Cache and contains Wyatt's Lost Papers 3 and Bunker Schematic Fragment 3. It must be placed in the Trade Drop Box as the 3rd Special Request to Sutherland to advance his questline.

fields.examine: An old lockbox.

title: Emergency Food
intro: The Emergency Food is an item found at the beginning of Episode 1: Do Not Go Gentle in the mission Memories. It is found inside the Jackrabbit Remote Transport, and is one of 3 extra items that can be placed inside Mackenzie's Floatplane (along with Astrid's Hardcase and Astrid's Backpack) before takeoff.

title: Field Dressing Your Kill, Vol. I
image: Field Dressing Your Kill, Vol. I icon.png

fields.name: Field Dressing Your Kill, Vol. I
fields.examine: Detailed information about the best way to butcher animal carcasses. Researching this will improve your Skill.

intro: Field Dressing Your Kill, Vol. I is a Research Book used to improve the Carcass Harvesting skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Fir Firewood

fields.name: Fir Firewood
fields.examine: While not technically a hardwood, fir burns like one.

intro: Fir Firewood is a fuel for fires in The Long Dark, it also is a material for repairing the Heavy Hammer.

title: Fire Barrel
intro: The fire barrel is an immovable contained fire in an open barrel. The fire barrel functions identically to other contained fires and player-made campfire. The fire barrel provides no advantage over other contained fires, but it does allow protection against wind, unlike the player-made campfire. It has two cooking slots.

title: Fire Hardened Arrow
intro: A Fire Hardened Arrow is a craftable ammunition for the Survival Bow made from a Campfire. It's made from (5) sticks and (5) crow feathers, and provides experience for the Archery skill when landed on a living target.

title: Firearm Cleaning Kit

fields.name: Firearm Cleaning Kit
fields.examine: Compact tool kit used to keep a Rifle or Revolver in good working order.

intro: The Firearm Cleaning Kit is a Tool for cleaning the Hunting Rifle and the Revolver (or their variants).

title: Firelog

fields.name: Firelog
fields.examine: Firelog made of chemicals and compressed shavings. Doesn't throw off much heat.

intro: Firelogs are one of the many sources of fuel that can be found on Great Bear Island.

title: Fireplace
intro: The fire place is an immovable contained fire. The fire place functions identically to other contained fires and player-made campfire. The fire place provides no advantage over other contained fires, but it does allow protection against wind, unlike the player-made campfire. It has two cooking slots.

title: Firestriker
intro: The Firestriker is a tool for lighting fires.

fields.name: First Aid Kit
fields.examine: Contains essential First Aid supplies.

title: Fishing Bait

fields.name: Fishing Bait
fields.examine: Basic fish bait. Useful for catching larger fish.

intro: Fishing Bait is a Tool used for Ice Fishing in The Long Dark. It released in the free update of Part 3: Frontier Comforts for the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Fishing Lure (Acorns)

fields.name: Fishing Lure (Acorns)
fields.examine: A solid, enticing lure. Improves the odds when fishing.

intro: Fishing Lure (Acorns) is the unofficial name given to one of 3 different fishing lures sharing the same name of Fishing Lure. It was introduced in the free update portion of the Part 3: Frontier Comforts portion of the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Fishing Lure (Revolver Shell Casing)

fields.name: Fishing Lure (Revolver Shell Casing)
fields.examine: A solid, enticing lure. Improves the odds when fishing.

intro: Fishing Lure (Revolver Shell Casing) is the unofficial name given to one of 3 different fishing lures sharing the same name of Fishing Lure. It was introduced in the free update portion of the Part 3: Frontier Comforts portion of the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Fishing Lure (Wire Bundle)

fields.name: Fishing Lure (Wire Bundle)
fields.examine: A solid, enticing lure. Improves the odds when fishing.

intro: Fishing Lure (Wire Bundle) is the unofficial name given to one of 3 different fishing lures sharing the same name of Fishing Lure. It was introduced in the free update portion of the Part 3: Frontier Comforts portion of the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Fishing Tackle

fields.name: Fishing Tackle
fields.examine: A hook and line used for catching fish.

intro: A Fishing Tackle is a Tool that is required to catch fish while Ice Fishing. It can also be used to repair clothing as part of the Mending survival skill or craft items at the Work Bench, in the same manner as a Sewing Kit.

title: Fishing Tip-Up

fields.name: Fishing Tip-Up
fields.examine: Leave at an ice fishing hole to catch fish unattended. Can also be set with Bait or a Lure.

intro: Fishing Tip-Ups are Ice Fishing and Trapping Tools used to passively catch fish. They were introduced in the free update portion of the Part 3: Frontier Comforts of the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Flare
intro: Flares are a multi-purpose tool in The Long Dark. They can be used as a light source, firestarter, or frightening wildlife.

title: Flare Shell

fields.name: Flare Shell
fields.examine: An emergency beacon fired from a Distress Pistol.

intro: Flare Shells are non-craftable ammunition items.

title: Flashlight
intro: For the unique version of the Flashlight, see Miner's Flashlight.

title: Forester's Revolver

fields.name: Forester's Revolver
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: An old, reliable weapon. Durable. Taken from a Breyerhouse worker by an unknown forest talker.

intro: The Forester's Revolver is an old double action, six-round chambered revolver. It has a soft green camouflage paint job and its wooden grip is wrapped with a white cloth. It's unique attribute is that each shot fired only degrades the gun by 0.75% condition instead of the standard revolvers 1% per shot. This means that it would take up to 133 shots to go from 100% to ruined, and can fire up to 266

title: Frontier Shooting Guide

fields.name: Frontier Shooting Guide
fields.examine: Reprint of a late 19th-century handbook about shooting, meant for green pioneers. Researching this will improve your Skill.

intro: Frontier Shooting Guide is a Research Book used to improve the Rifle Firearm skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Furnace
intro: A Furnace is an unmovable contained fire. Notably, furnaces also have an attached Forge that can be used for crafting items. Furnaces have a maximum temperature of 200°C. Minimum temperature for forging is 150°C. To achieve a temperature above 80°C, Coal must be added to the furnace. For Cooking and heating, the furnace functions identically to other contained fires and player-made Campfire. It pr

title: Hacksaw

fields.repair: [Simple Tools] or [Quality Tools]; 1 × [Scrap Metal]; 25% Condition; 45 to 30 min

intro: The Hacksaw is a tool with several critical functions, including harvesting saplings and furniture made of a variety of materials. Scrap Metal is required to repair it.

title: Handheld Shortwave Radio

fields.name: Handheld Shortwave Radio
fields.examine: With a working Transmitter in range, home in on distant objects by navigating in the direction of the highest signal strength. The Shortwave's default tracking mode will detect signals of unknown origin, while its secondary setting is useful for locating hidden supply caches or downed aircraft. ; Useless indoors or underground.

intro: Useless indoors or underground.

title: Hatchet
intro: The Hatchet is a tool in The Long Dark, primarily for woodcutting and self defense.

title: Heavy Hammer
intro: The Heavy Hammer is a multi-purpose tool, but is essential for Forging: which is the only means for the survivor to craft their own tools, the Improvised Hatchet, Improvised Knife and Arrowheads. Hammers lose small amounts of condition when used to forge, break furniture, or make holes in the ice, or during a struggle if selected.

title: Hook

fields.name: Hook
fields.examine: A basic hook suitable for fishing.

intro: A Hook is a tool that is required for building a Fishing Tackle. It can either be found or constructed on a Work Bench from Scrap Metal. They can be hard to spot in the world, but can often be found near Work Benches or inside Fishing Huts.

title: Hunter's Revolver

fields.name: Hunter's Revolver
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: Vintage, hand-cannon style. Its stout construction allows for deadlier shots at distance.

intro: The Hunter's Revolver is an artfully engraved and blued firearm with a distinct ivory grip featuring a diamond shaped insert. It has an extra long barrel enabling it to land hits from twice as far away, but the extra material makes it weigh 0.25 Kg more than the standard revolver.

title: Hunting Knife
intro: The Hunting Knife is a tool in The Long Dark for butchering, crafting and self defense.

title: Hunting Lodge Rifle
intro: The Hunting Lodge Rifle is the unofficial name given to a Tool simply named Hunting Rifle that was found in Episode 2: Luminance Fugue of the Wintermute story mode as part of the mission You Fix My Rifle?. It is considered Cut/Discontinued Content, as it did not survive the transition from Predux Episode 2 to Redux Episode 2, as the item located where the Hunting Lodge Rifle was found would be rep

title: Hunting Rifle
intro: This article is about the normal hunting rifle. For variants, see Vaughn's Rifle, Barb's Rifle, Bunker Rifle, or Curator's Rifle.

title: Improvised Down Bedroll
intro: 5 × Ptarmigan Down;

title: Improvised Hatchet
intro: The Improvised Hatchet is a tool in The Long Dark, primarily for woodcutting and self defense.

title: Improvised Knife
intro: The Improvised Knife is a tool in The Long Dark for butchering, crafting and self defense.

title: Insulated Flask

fields.name: Insulated Flask
fields.examine: A portable container for keeping beverages warm.

intro: The Insulated Flask (otherwise known as a Thermos) is a Tool that was released as part of the free update for the Tales from the Far Territory expansion Part Four.

title: Jeremiah's Knife

fields.examine: A superior quality hunting knife. A gift from Jeremiah

intro: Jeremiah's Knife was a tool in pre-redux Wintermute from Episode 2. it was removed in the 2018 Redux release of Episode 2.

title: Jerry Can
intro: A Jerry Can is a large container that can hold up to 4 liters (1.05 Gallons) of Lantern Fuel.

title: Lantern Fuel
intro: Lantern Fuel is a container of kerosene fuel for the Storm Lantern. It can also be used as an optional accelerant for starting fires or an ingredient for crafting a Torch.

title: Line

fields.name: Line
fields.examine: A line suitable for fishing.

intro: A Line is a tool that is required for building a Fishing Tackle. Line can either constructed at a Work Bench from Cured Gut, or can occasionally be found when searching containers.

title: Magnifying Lens
intro: A Magnifying Lens is a tool used to start fires.

title: Manufactured Arrow

fields.examine: Commercially crafted Arrows made of metal alloy. Heavier, but more deadly and durable.

intro: Manufactured arrows resemble a modern fixed blade broadhead hunting arrow with a steel-alloy head and synthetic fletching and shaft. It can only be acquired by trading with the Trader after completion of his first special request. Manufactured Arrows are a pure upgrade from Simple Arrows, dealing more damage and being twice as durable, but cannot be repaired once broken and must be replaced outrig

title: Marine Flare
intro: Marine Flares are a multi-purpose tool in The Long Dark. They can be used as a light source, firestarter, or frightening Wildlife.

title: Miner's Flashlight

fields.name: Miner's Flashlight
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: An industrial Flashlight. Equipped with a larger, more-efficient battery.

intro: The Miner's Flashlight is a yellow, heavy duty electrical torch that has a larger, longer lasting battery than the regular Flashlight, but at the expense of being 0.25 kg heavier. While a 100% charged Miner's Flashlight lasts for up to 1,5 hours of continuous use (50% more than the regular Flashlight), the high beam mode lasts the same 25 seconds.

title: Mountaineering Rope

fields.name: Mountaineering Rope
fields.examine: Heavy-duty rope designed for climbing.

intro: Mountaineering Rope is a tool used for climbing cliff faces.

title: Newsprint
intro: A newsprint is a material that can be used as tinder.

title: Newsprint Roll
intro: Newsprint Roll is a material item that can be used as tinder.

title: Noisemaker

fields.name: Noisemaker
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: An improvised explosive. Useful for scaring predators but can cause injury if they explode too close.

intro: Noisemakers (also nicknamed Pipebombs), are a tool in The Long Dark. They are primarily used for frightening Wildlife, but can be used to offensively kill animals.

title: Pot Belly Stove
intro: The Pot Belly Stove is an immovable contained fire. The pot belly stove functions identically to other contained fires and player-made Campfire. The pot belly stove provides no advantage over other contained fires, but it does allow protection against wind, unlike the player-made campfire. It has one Cooking slot.

title: Practical Gunsmithing

fields.name: Practical Gunsmithing
fields.examine: A do-it-yourself guide to gunsmithing techniques, intended for hunters but loved by the security-minded. Researching this will improve your Gunsmithing Skill.

intro: Practical Gunsmithing is a Research Book used to improve the Gunsmithing skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Prybar
intro: Prybar is a Tool used to open locked containers, such as lockers and Car trunks (they cannot be used to open Cargo Containers). It is additionally used to break the ice on ice-fishing holes, and as a weapon during Struggles. They cannot be repaired but can be harvested for some Scrap Metal. Prybars are fairly common and can be found in almost any condition. It's one of the most important early gam

title: Quality Tools
intro: Quality Tools are a Tool item used for crafting items and repairing equipment.

title: Reclaimed Wood

fields.name: Reclaimed Wood
fields.examine: Reclaimed wood (from broken furniture, wooden structures, etc.)

intro: Reclaimed Wood is a fuel and crafting material in The Long Dark.

title: Recycled Can

fields.name: Recycled Can
fields.examine: A basic container for melting snow, boiling water, and cooking food.

intro: A Recycled Can is a tool that players used primarily for melting snow, boiling water, and cooking canned goods and drinks.

title: Replacement Fuse

fields.name: Replacement Fuse
fields.examine: Electrical fuse. Looks old, but appears to be in working order.

intro: }}The Replacement Fuse is an item that was first added in Episode 3 of Story Mode. It was later added to survival mode in the Tales from the Far Territory DLC.

title: Revolver
intro: This article is about the normal revolver. For variants, see Hunter's Revolver, Forester's Revolver, and Warden's Revolver.

title: Revolver Ammunition

fields.name: Revolver ammunition
fields.harvest: Chance to produce: 1 × [Bullet] 1 × [Revolver Shell Casing] 0.01kg x [Can of Gunpowder] 5 minutes

intro: Revolver Ammunition and Revolver Cartridge is ammunition for the Revolver. It can be found alone, as a single round, or as 10 rounds in a box. It can also be crafted at an Ammunition Work Bench. The box is branded as a product called Bullseye.

title: Rifle Ammunition
intro: Rifle Ammunition and Rifle Cartridge is .303 ammunition for the Hunting Rifle. It can be found as a single round, or in boxes of 5. It can also be crafted at an Ammunition Work Bench. The box is branded as a product called Bullseye.

title: Rim Grill
intro: The rim grill is an immovable contained fire introduced in the Errant Pilgrim update. The rim grill functions identically to other contained fires and player-made Campfire. The rim grill provides no advantage over other contained fires, but it does allow protection against wind, unlike the player-made campfire. It has two Cooking slots.

title: Scrap Metal Shard
intro: Scrap Metal Shard is Tool exclusive to Wintermute.

title: Sewing Kit
intro: Sewing Kit is a tool in The Long Dark for repairing Clothing or crafting improvised clothing.

title: Shotgun

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things]
fields.examine: A long barreled, single shot, break action shotgun. Calibrated to fire Slug rounds. A deadly, if slow firing weapon.

intro: The Shotgun is a Tools item found exclusively in Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things in the Wintermute story of The Long Dark.

title: Shotgun Ammunition

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things]
fields.examine: A box of Shotgun slugs. ; A single shotgun slug shell.

intro: Shotgun Ammunition icon.png|Ammunition

title: Shotgun Shell Casing

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things]
fields.examine: Empty casing from firing a Shotgun Slug. Used for Crafting new Ammunition

intro: It is produced whenever Shotgun Ammunition is fired from a Shotgun. Once the Shotgun is reloaded, a Shotgun Shell Casing is deposited onto the ground that can be picked up. The Shotgun can also be unloaded in the Backpack, depositing the Shotgun Shell Casing into the player's inventory.

title: Simple Arrow
intro: Simple Arrows are craftable ammunition items for Survival Bows.

title: Simple Fishing Lure

fields.name: Simple Fishing Lure
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Leave It, Place it
fields.examine: A very basic lure, might help you attract a few more fish.

intro: Simple Fishing Lure is a basic Fishing Lure introduced in the free update portion of the Part 3: Frontier Comforts update for the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Simple Tools
intro: Simple Tools are a Tool item used for crafting simple items and repairing equipment.

title: Small Arms Handbook

fields.name: Small Arms Handbook
fields.examine: A manual with details on effective handgun shooting and maintenance. Researching this will improve your Revolver Firearm Skill.

intro: A Sewing Primer is a Research Book used to improve the Revolver Firearm skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Snare
intro: The Snare is a type of tool.

title: Spear Head

fields.name: Spear Head
fields.examine: The business end of a Bear Spear. Rough-hammered, but effective. Crafted from Scrap Metal.

intro: Spear Head is a Tool found in Episode 2 of the Wintermute story mode. It is created in a Forge in order to repair the Broken Bear Spear in the mission The Best Defense. Once forged, it is instantly combined with the Broken Bear Spear to create the Bear Spear.

title: Spelunker's Lantern

fields.name: Spelunker's Lantern
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: Rigged for fuel efficiency. A light for deep, dark places, when other lights go out.

intro: Spelunker's Lantern is a mobile source of light and Warmth which does not require Matches or other firestarters to ignite. The lantern's flame is also windproof, but unlike Flares it will not deter wolves. The lantern requires no external ignition source due to the internal auto-igniter, unlike Torches. This allows the Spelunker's Lantern to be quickly extinguished and ignited at any point, so lon

title: Sport Bow

fields.name: Sport Bow
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: A light and durable manufactured Bow. A trusty companion on or off the archery range.

intro: }}Sport Bow is a unique variant of the Survival Bow in The Long Dark, added by the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Spray Paint
intro: Spray Paint is a mapping and information tool in The Long Dark.

title: Spray Paint - Glyph
intro: Spray Paint - Glygh is the name given to a unique type of Spray Paint found in the Escape the Darkwalker Challenge. They are vital to surviving and ultimately escaping The Darkwalker.

title: Stack of Papers
intro: A Stack of Papers is a material item used as tinder.

title: Stay on Target

fields.name: Stay on Target
fields.examine: A detailed guide to hunting with bows. Researching it will improve your Archery Skill.

intro: Stay on Target is a Research Book used to improve the Archery skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Stick

fields.name: Stick
fields.examine: Small stick, will burn, but not for long.

intro: Sticks are a crafting material and fuel material in The Long Dark.

title: Stone

fields.name: Stone
fields.actions: Toss from hip, Aim and Throw
fields.examine: A small stone. Big enough to stun a small animal. Might be enough to scare off a bigger one.

intro: A Stone is a throwable item found scattered around all maps. It can be picked up and used as a distraction or make-shift weapon against Wolves.

title: Storm Lantern

fields.name: Storm Lantern
fields.repair: [Simple Tools] or [Quality Tools] 1 × [Scrap Metal]; 45 to 30 min

intro: For the unique variant of the Storm Lantern, see Spelunker's Lantern.

title: Stove
intro: The Stove (technically a kitchen stove) is an immovable fire barrel. The wood stove functions identically to other contained fires and player-made Campfire, and, like all contained fires, isn't blown out by high winds.

title: Survival Bow
intro: This article is about the normal Bow. For variants, see Woodwright's Bow, Sport Bow and Bushcraft Bow.

title: Survival Knife

fields.examine: A durable, heavy Knife with a finely-honed edge. Excels at Harvesting meat from frozen carcasses.

intro: A rare variant of the Hunting Knife that is only acquired when trading with the Trader, the Survival Knife boasts impressive stats for its rarity. Its edge is serrated, allowing it to do more damage in a Struggle while also allowing it to perform Carcass Harvesting faster than a normal knife. The tradeoff is that it is a little bit heavier than a normal Hunting Knife, but an added bonus of this kn

title: Survive the Outdoors!

fields.name: Survive the Outdoors!
fields.examine: Handbook with information on wilderness survival. Researching this will improve your Skill.

intro: Survive the Outdoors! is a Research Book used to improve the Fire Starting skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: The Frozen Angler

fields.name: The Frozen Angler
fields.examine: An instructional manual on ice fishing. Researching this will improve your Skill.

intro: The Frozen Angler is a Research Book used to improve the Ice Fishing skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Tinder Plug
intro: A Tinder Plug is a material item used as Tinder.

title: Torch

fields.name: Torch
fields.examine: A simple torch -- the same kind that's dispelled the darkness for thousands of years. Might even keep the Wolves at bay.

intro: Grey Mother: "My rifle stays with me. But, there might be other ways. In the old days, we used to scare them off with fire. A torch would do the trick. We used to make them out of pieces of wood, and a rag dipped in kerosene."|2=Mackenzie and Grey Mother}}A Torch is a craftable tool that creates light and a small amount of heat, adding +3°C to your "Feels Like" temperature. If more than one is dro

title: Travois

fields.name: Travois
fields.examine: A timeless and efficient way to drag loads over long distances. Take care to remember there are some places a Travois can't travel. Can be collapsed for convenient carrying, when empty.

intro: Travois (pronounced Trav-wah) are a crafted vehicle for item transportation and storage in The Long Dark. They can be loaded with large amounts of items, then manually dragged to move them. It was introduced in Part 4 "Buried Echoes" update for Tales from the Far Territory.

title: Vaughn's Rifle

fields.name: Vaughn's Rifle
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: A weathered .303 Rifle covered in epoxy and duct tape. Its patchwork exterior hides an improved firing action. A handy tool when working the various industrial sites and power stations that dot Great Bear Island.; ; Fragile and deadly, just like its owner.

intro: Vaughn's Rifle trades durability for a lighter weight and responsiveness. Weighing 1.0kg less than the standard Hunting Rifle and featuring shortened firing delays on reload and aim, this rifle variant has much snappier handling and a slightly faster fire rate overall. The downside is that each shot uses 2% condition, compared to the normal rifle consuming 1.325% condition per use. This means the

title: Warden's Revolver

fields.name: Warden's Revolver
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: Quick draw sidearm. Out of place in the wilderness, but its short barrel and light weight allow for a faster aiming action.

intro: The Warden's Revolver has been modified for portability with a snub-nose barrel, and custom blue grip featuring golden four leaf clover inlays. It has the lowest weight of any firearm available; weighing 0.25 Kg less than the standard revolver, and has a 25% faster aiming action. The downside is that the guns effective range is reduced by 33%.

title: Whetstone

fields.name: Whetstone
fields.examine: A whetstone used to sharpen blades.

intro: The Whetstone, or Sharpening Stone, is a tool used to sharpen bladed tools.

title: Wilderness Kitchen

fields.name: Wilderness Kitchen
fields.examine: Tips and tricks on how to prepare food in the wilderness. Researching this will improve your Skill.

intro: Wilderness Kitchen is a Research Book used to improve the Cooking skill. It can also be used as Fuel when starting a Fire.

title: Wires

fields.examine: A bundle of scavenged Wires. Old, but intact.

intro: *2 are used to repair Transmitters across Great Bear Island.

title: Wood Matches
intro: Wood Matches are a Fire Starting Tools and a small light source in The Long Dark.

title: Wood Stove
intro: A Wood Stove is an immovable contained fire. The wood stove functions identically to other contained fires and player-made campfire. The wood stove provides no advantage over other contained fires, but it does allow protection against wind, unlike the player-made campfire. It has two cooking slots.

title: Woodworking Tools

fields.examine: Tools for Crafting furniture and decorative items.

intro: Woodworking Tools is a tool used to craft furniture for the Safehouse Customization feature.

title: Woodwright's Bow

fields.name: Woodwright's Bow
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Equip It, Leave It
fields.examine: Crafted at a master's Work Bench. Every shape and angle reflects a careful and knowing touch.; ; A more durable and agile Survival Bow.

intro: }}Woodwright's Bow is a unique variant of the Survival Bow in The Long Dark, added by the Tales from the Far Territory expansion.

title: Wyatt's Skeleton

fields.examine: Human remains. Some of the bones appear burnt.

intro: It is found in the Trade Drop Box after starting the 5th Special Request, and must be returned back to the Prepper's Abandoned Cache with a Wire Bundle, then destroying the cache to advance Sutherland's questline.
